cases.trigger: Dynamically loaded Quick View or cart UI uses a class styled only in unrelated Liquid file.
cases.documented_risk: Styles can be absent after Shopify subsets stylesheets by rendered component tree; Expanse v10.0.1 reports fixing this class of issue.
cases.vsn_design_action: Make each module own its CSS; share global utilities through a stable assets stylesheet.
cases.qa_gate: Theme Check ValidScopedCSSClass; inspect computed style after dynamic cart/quick-add render.

cases.trigger: Part of Section Rendering API response is inserted into DOM.
cases.documented_risk: Response includes style[data-section-stylesheet]; partial extraction may remove it.
cases.vsn_design_action: Preserve required data-section-stylesheet tags when injecting partial response, or insert full section.
cases.qa_gate: Verify styling after predictive search, quick view and cart replacement.

cases.trigger: Product contains >250 variants but code loops product.variants.
cases.documented_risk: Shopify Liquid product.variants returns at most 250; vendor moved high variant products to normal product template.
cases.vsn_design_action: Use option-value APIs and dynamic fetch rather than preloading all variants in Liquid.
cases.qa_gate: Test real 251+ and 1000+ variants on PDP, quick add and unavailable combinations.

cases.trigger: Variant selection changes availability, price and pickup status.
cases.documented_risk: Vendor release notes describe past stale inventory/pickup and unavailable buy-button states, since fixed in that theme.
cases.vsn_design_action: Derive all product promises from the same current selected variant; cancel stale requests.
cases.qa_gate: Rapid multi-variant toggles and delayed network QA.

cases.trigger: Merchant changes a section/block in Theme Editor, dynamically replacing HTML.
cases.documented_risk: Page-load JS does not automatically run on editor section re-render.
cases.vsn_design_action: Register Shopify editor load/unload/select events; ensure sliders show selected block and pause.
cases.qa_gate: Test editor add/reorder/remove and no duplicate JS listeners.

cases.trigger: Collection builds many product cards and dynamic fragments.
cases.documented_risk: Excess individual stylesheets increase parsing/style recalculation work.
cases.vsn_design_action: One stable component stylesheet, never append stylesheet link for every card.
cases.qa_gate: Count CSS requests and verify responsiveness and actual INP.
